# M Residences

> M Residences is a residential tower on Al Mankhool Road in Bur Dubai, a short walk from Al Fahidi metro station and the historic Creek district. It rises above three basement parking levels and holds 89 apartments, from one-bedroom flats to four-bedroom duplexes. Residents share a swimming pool, a gymnasium, landscaped gardens, a barbecue area and a children's playground, with a covered parking space allocated to every home.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Mankhool, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

M Residences is a residential tower on Al Mankhool Road in Bur Dubai, developed by H&H, the property arm of Mawarid Finance. The building rises above three basement levels of parking and offers a mix of one- to four-bedroom apartments. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the 3B+G+23+R tower, working with DXB Lab Architecture as consultant.
